input.free_text_description: The system operates in the microservices infrastructure, recruitment domain. It serves API Consumer, Customer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include order, position, ribbon hystrix. Core business data revolves around Candidate, Driver, DriverStatus, DriverStatusRepo.

user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to place and track orders, so that I can purchase items and monitor their delivery status.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage position operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage ribbon hystrix operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage user api operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
